schema.description:
Order type. Valid values: 
- INSTANCE_BUY: Product purchase 
- INSTANCE_RENEW: Instance renewal 
- INSTANCE_UPGRADE: Instance upgrade

Order commodity information. 

You can serialize the corresponding commodity based on the specified OrderType.

The CommodityType corresponding to each OrderType is as follows: 
* INSTANCE_BUY: InstanceBuyCommodity
* INSTANCE_RENEW: InstanceRenewCommodity
* INSTANCE_UPGRADE: InstanceUpgradeCommodity

The parameters in the Commodity example are described below:
- Required parameters
  - productCode: Product code
  - skuCode: Product SKU code. For subscription, it is fixed as "prepay". For pay-as-you-go, it is fixed as "postpay".
  - duration: Quantity of epochs, such as 1, 2, 3...
  - pricingCycle: Epoch unit. Valid values: Day, Month, Year.
  - components: Specification modules. The package_version module is required. Other modules depend on the product settings.

- Optional parameters
  - quantity: Purchase quantity
  - queryPromotion: Whether to query promotions
  - couponId: Coupon ID
  - properties: Order extension property string, in JSON dict format
Order source (not enabled)

Payment method:
* AUTO: Automatic payment from balance
* HAND: Manual payment

This parameter is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.  
The client generates the parameter value, which must be unique across different requests and contain no more than 64 ASCII characters.

PushMeteringData.summary: Invoke PushMeteringData to push metering data.

schema.description:
The parameter descriptions in the sample are as follows:

- InstanceId: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace instance ID. Parameter type: String.
- StartTime: Metering start time, in seconds (formatted as a UNIX timestamp, for example, 1723771200). Parameter type: Long.
- EndTime: Metering end time, in seconds (formatted as a UNIX timestamp, for example, 1723771800). Parameter type: Long.
- Entities: Metering entity objects. Parameter type: List<Map>.
    - Key: Name of the metering item property. Parameter type: String.
        - Frequency: Usage count (times).
        - Period: Usage duration in hours (seconds).

         Note: The duration unit in the request parameter is seconds, while the billing unit is hours. Therefore, during billing, the value is converted to hours. For example, if the usage from 19:00 to 20:00 is 1800 seconds and the billing rate is CNY 1 per hour, the billed amount for this period is 1800 / 3600 × 1 = 0.5 CNY. If the fee contains decimals, retain two decimal places and discard any digits beyond the second decimal place.

        - Storage: Storage space used (Bytes).

         Note: The unit in the request parameter is Bytes, while the billing unit is MB. Therefore, during billing, the value is converted to MB. For example, if the usage from 19:00 to 20:00 is 524288 Bytes and the billing rate is CNY 1 per MB, the billed amount for this period is 524288 / 1024 / 1024 × 1 = 0.5 CNY. If the fee contains decimals, retain two decimal places and discard any digits beyond the second decimal place.

        - NetworkOut: Outbound traffic used (Bits).

         Note: The unit in the request parameter is Bits, while the billing unit is Mb. Therefore, during billing, the value is converted to Mb. For example, if the usage from 19:00 to 20:00 is 524288 Bits and the billing rate is CNY 1 per Mb, the billed amount for this period is 524288 / 1024 / 1024 × 1 = 0.5 CNY. If the fee contains decimals, retain two decimal places and discard any digits beyond the second decimal place.

        - NetworkIn: Inbound traffic used (Bits).

         Note: The unit in the request parameter is Bits, while the billing unit is Mb. Therefore, during billing, the value is converted to Mb. For example, if the usage from 19:00 to 20:00 is 524288 Bits and the billing rate is CNY 1 per Mb, the billed amount for this period is 524288 / 1024 / 1024 × 1 = 0.5 CNY. If the fee contains decimals, retain two decimal places and discard any digits beyond the second decimal place.

        - Character: Number of characters (count).
        - DailyActiveUser: Daily active user count (DAU).
        - PeriodMin: Usage duration in minutes (minutes).
        - VirtualCpu: Number of virtual CPU cores.
        - Unit: Unit (count).
        - Memory: Memory (GB).

        - KTokens: Number of tokens used (tokens).

         Note: The KTokens unit in the request parameter is tokens, not kilo-tokens. However, the billing unit is kilo-tokens. Therefore, during billing, the token value in the metering parameter is converted to kilo-tokens. For example, if the usage from 19:00 to 20:00 is 1500 tokens, with the sample payload: {"Key":"KTokens","Value":"1500","meteringAssit":"cmapi00071246-KTokens-1"}, and the billing rate is CNY 1 per kilo-token, the billed amount for this period is 1500 / 1000 × 1 = 1.5 CNY. If the fee contains decimals, retain two decimal places and discard any digits beyond the second decimal place.

        - Suit: Suit (set). Note that the value passed in the parameter is in sets.
        - StorageGigaByte: StorageGigaByte (storage space in GB). Note that the parameter passed directly uses GB as the unit and does not need conversion to Bytes or other units.

    - Value: Metering numeric value (value ≥ 0). Parameter type: Integer.
    - meteringAssit: Multi-dimensional metering item ID. Parameter type: String. This billing item ID can be found in the product publishing backend. Each billing item, such as Frequency, has one or more associated IDs. When pushing metering data for newly published products, this parameter must be included.

**Notes**:
- Multi-dimensional metering capability is now supported. For billing items such as Frequency (times), Period (usage duration), and PeriodMin, multiple instances of the same billing item type can be defined when publishing a product. For example, a single product can include multiple PeriodMin billing items. Each PeriodMin billing item is assigned a unique ID to identify it, generated during product publishing, with a format such as (cmapi00060317-PeriodMin-3, cmapi00060317-PeriodMin-4). When pushing metering data, this ID must be included to enable accurate billing deductions. The metering data format for newly published products is shown below:
schema.example:
按小时/按天推量时：
[{"InstanceId":"1000001","StartTime":"100000000","EndTime":"100000010","Entities":[{"Key":"PeriodMin","Value":"96","meteringAssit":"cmapi00060317-PeriodMin-4"}]}]


大模型场景实时推量时：
[{"InstanceId":"1000001","SerialNo":"210f470417561055092582279ea052","StartTime":"100000000","EndTime":"100000010","Entities":[{"Key":"PeriodMin","Value":"96","meteringAssit":"cmapi00060317-PeriodMin-4"}]}]

PushMeteringData.title: Push Metering Data
PushMeteringData.description:
- All request parameters must be URL-encoded.  
- Alibaba Cloud Marketplace enforces a rate limit of one request per 60 seconds for each InstanceId, and each request supports up to 100 metering data records.  
- Batch pushing of InstanceIds across different Products is not supported. When performing batch pushes, ensure all InstanceIds belong to the same Product.  
- When batch pushing metering data, all values of the "InstanceId" property must correspond to instances generated from the same Product. Pushing instances from multiple Products simultaneously is currently unsupported.  
- For Products billed hourly, metering data must be pushed before the billing cutoff time of the next hour. For example, if the metering data covers the period from 08:10 to 08:20, it must be pushed before 09:59; otherwise, billing will not occur. Similarly, for daily-billed Products, data for the previous day must be pushed before 01:59 the following day; otherwise, the push will fail and no billing will occur.  
- If the Product is configured for real-time billing, StartTime and EndTime can span any duration, but EndTime must be strictly greater than StartTime.  
- If the Product is configured for non-real-time billing (for example, hourly, daily, or monthly), the interval between StartTime and EndTime must be greater than 5 minutes.  
- Note that the Metering field in the parameters must be submitted strictly according to the Sample provided in the document. In the past, many submissions failed because the Metering field was not a valid JSON object. Before submission, verify the format using a JSON formatting tool to avoid API call failures. Please check carefully.  
- Note that if an instance has expired, any metering data pushed after the expiration time will not be billed. For example, if an instance expires at 2025-07-09 12:20:00, metering data for the period 2025-07-09 13:00:00 to 2025-07-09 14:00:00 will not be billed. However, metering data for the period 2025-07-09 12:00:00 to 2025-07-09 13:00:00 can still be billed normally.  
- After pushing metering data, billing does not occur immediately. For hourly billing, the bill for the period 08:00–09:00 will be generated after 10:00. For daily billing, the bill will be generated the following day. Once billed, Customers can View the details in [Alibaba Cloud Bill Details](https://usercenter2.aliyun.com/finance/expense-report/expense-detail-by-instance).
